programme.desc: Castleford host Hull KR in the Betfred Super League. Challenge Cup winners Hull KR put the struggling Dragons to the sword last week as the celebrations continued for Tom Davies and co.

programme.desc: St Helens host Catalans Dragons in the Betfred Super League. Saints ran away with a 40-10 win over Leeds Rhinos last week to go top of the table. (31.05)

programme.desc: At AMT Headingley Stadium, Leeds Rhinos and York Valkyrie battle it out in a Betfred Women's Super League semi-final. (22.09)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights

programme.title: S/Lge: Huddersfield v Leigh
programme.desc: Luke Robinson's Huddersfield Giants play host to Leigh Leopards in the Betfred Super League. Leigh's play-off hopes were dealt a blow last week in defeat to the Black and Whites.

programme.title: S/Lge: Hull KR v St Helens
programme.desc: Table toppers Hull KR play host to St Helens in the Betfred Super League. Last week, the Robins gained the psychological edge over Warrington ahead of their Wembley Challenge Cup meeting.
